 Order

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No.886 of 2023 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Morena (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 354, 376 (DA), 376 (3), 342, 120B 366 (A )of of IPC, Sections 3/4,
5(G)6, 9 (L)10 of POCSO Act and Sections 146/196, 3/181 of Motor Vehicles Act.
First application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn by this Court vide order dated 29.01.2024 in M.Cr.C.No.3531 of 2024.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argued that applicant is innocent and h a s been falsely implicated.
It is further argued that allegedly the applicant/accused committed rape upon prosecutrix, however, DNA report dated 07.02.2024 does not corroborate in respect of applicant/accused.
Under these circumstances, entire prosecution story becomes suspicious in respect to present applicant/accused.
Even prosecution story is also highly improbable, in the light of the fact that after the alleged incident, victim again visited the house of co-accused persons Mukesh and Sonu.

After conclusion of investigation, charge sheet has already been filed, therefore,
his custodial interrogation is not required anymore.
Further submission is that co-accused Vikas Dhakad has already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 04.03.2024 in M.Cr.C.No.9171 of 2024.
The applicant is under custody since 08.09.2023.
The applicant is having no criminal history.
The applicant is resident of District Shivpuri (M.P.) and there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Hence, prayed for grant of bail to the applicant.
On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer for respondent/State vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/Committal Court.
